Dear Oulun Putkiasennus,

We're sorry for the delay in getting this sorted, and thank you for your patience.

Since our technician confirmed the fault with the unit was on our end, and it was out of service for two full days of your rental, you're entitled to a pro-rated refund for those two days plus a goodwill credit, in line with our policy on confirmed equipment faults. We'll apply this to your account and follow up with the exact figures shortly.

Apologies again for the oversight, and thank you for raising it with us.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service
